stage_note: Design (smallest change): poll statuses active, out_of_stock, dead_link; order by oldest last non-skipped observation (nulls first), round-robin across marketplaces, 10-minute run limit, per-site spacing measured since that site's last fetch. record_observation: status transitions recorded in parse_flags.status_transition (restocked out_of_stock->active when seen in stock; link_recovered dead_link->active on a good parse); meta_json.consecutive_failures/last_failure_at count 404/410 dead results and reset on a good parse; the poller skips listings in back-off (3 consecutive, 24 h since last failure) without writing rows. Any 403/429 from a site during a listing fetch: no more requests to that site in the run, observation records parse_flags.site_paused, Redis key cip:listing_capture:site_pause:<mkt> holds until/hours (1 h doubling to 24 h, memory TTL hours+24 h, cleared on the next 200 from that site). Browser UA constant replaces CIP-listing-capture/1.0. Supervisor worker ExtraEnv gains the two flags ('1'); status.json env reports what the worker receives.
